summary: Full backend+frontend testing of QAKK MVP. 15/15 pytest backend tests pass. Playwright end-to-end covering admin login, worker create, worker login, check-in, check-out (4h rule), Recent Shifts, Edit Hours override, Force Check-out, Active Locations, EN/DA lang toggle, role-separation, cron auth — all pass.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — FastAPI recommends lifespan handler.
allow_credentials=False but middleware is added AFTER app.include_router — works, but ordering is fragile; also wildcard origins for a licensed app is loose.
No 404 when worker_id has no match — silently returns whatever find_one gives (currently masked because we then find_one by id).

issues: During AnimatePresence transition, previous offline inputs briefly overlap with online panel (visual only).

action_items: Consider migrating startup/shutdown to FastAPI lifespan handler.
Add 404 in worker update when the worker/role filter matches 0 documents.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py 623 lines — approaching the split threshold; consider modularizing (auth/, shifts/, admin/, cron/).
CORS middleware added after include_router — works but non-idiomatic.
seed_admin correctly upserts password if it changed — good.
Bcrypt hashes use bcrypt.gensalt() ($2b$...) — verified via successful admin login.
MongoDB ObjectId is properly excluded via serialize_* helpers.
Cron endpoints use secrets.compare_digest with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET — verified 401/2xx behavior.
test_credentials: Admin jaki960119@gmail.hu / Admin1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test worker created dynamically per run (pw_<ts>@qakk.dk / Worker1234).
seed_data_creation: Playwright tests create and clean up their own workers. Backend pytest creates ephemeral worker (test_worker_<ts>@qakk.dk) and deletes it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/backend_test.py`. pytest.ini has xdist -n auto flag but xdist conflicts with fixture ordering here; -o addopts='' overrides it. Note: EmailStr rejects .test TLD — use @qakk.dk for test emails. GPS is unavailable in headless, so checkin_street is null (accepted). AnimatePresence briefly overlaps offline/online views — wait ~1.5-2s before asserting the online panel content.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial test failure was tooling: EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD; switched to '.dk'. Second Playwright failure was flake asserting input hidden immediately after check-in during AnimatePresence exit animation — added a small settle wait.
